reason: Hypothesis A proposes a physically sound, specific, and testable mechanism (high-entropy fluorite oxide support stabilizing atomically dispersed PGMs) directly relevant to high-temperature exhaust conditions, and extends prior work on high-entropy oxides for catalysis, whereas Hypothesis B relies on an organic melamine coating unlikely to survive the harsh oxidative, high-temperature automotive exhaust environment and inappropriately extrapolates from low-temperature fuel cell electrocatalysis.
